values.note: 'There are no reserving of camping spots.' Payment is due for every night a vehicle holds a spot. Call the camp host, (402) 297-2878, to ask what is open.
City of Weeping Water: electric sites $25, tents $10; no reservations.

note: City of Weeping Water park campground beside two small fishing ponds (~2 acres each) and Weeping Water Creek. ~22 sites, 50-amp electric on level concrete pads; no per-site water but fill faucets in the park; dump station at the park entrance. No reservations; pay nightly. Camp host (402) 297-2878. Paved walk/bike path around the ponds. --Claude
summary: The city page confirms $25 electric sites, $10 tents and no reservations; booking and fees are written as manual. The 'lake' is two ponds of about 1.5-2.5 acres each, measured on NAIP. An NGPC listing snippet gives 4 acres for the Weeping Water pond. That is under the 5-acre line, so there is no pond value. The campground's own loop road also lies between the pond-side pads and the water. The call goes down lakefront -> not waterfront. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT CHANGED lakefront -> not waterfront. The water is two city ponds split by a footbridge. NAIP pixel fill gives ~1.6 and ~1.5 acres (bounding boxes ~137x152 m and ~169x103 m, so at most ~2.5 acres each), and the NGPC fishing listing snippet says 'Weeping Water Pond ... 4 acres'. Both are under the ~5-acre pond line, and there is no pond-view. The pond-side pads also sit across the campground loop road. Weeping Water Creek runs 40-60 m south of the west loop, behind the loop road and a tree belt, and is creek-width.
FEES/BOOKING confirmed: $25 electric / $10 tent, no reservations (the page is undated beyond its ©2026 footer).
PIN OK: stored 40.86995,-96.14710 is ~95 m from the west herringbone RV loop centre (~40.8702,-96.1482) and between the two loops. Google's point 40.86960,-96.14587 is at the pavilion.
PHONE 402-267-5152 confirmed (city office on the page + Google). Camp host (402) 297-2878 is in the note.
Site count (~22) and 50 A concrete pads not re-confirmed: the page no longer states them. Hookups, sites and facilities left as derived.
